title: Chino Commercial Bancorp Reports 8.7% Increase in Net Earnings
summary: Chino Commercial Bancorp reported an 8.7% increase in net earnings for the first quarter ended March 31, 2025. The company's Board of Directors released results for both the bank and the consolidated holding company, with the announcement issued from Chino, California via Globe Newswire.
content:
CHINO, Calif., April 18, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Board of Directors of Chino Commercial Bancorp (OTC: CCBC), the parent company of Chino Commercial Bank, N.A., announced the results of operations for the Bank and the consolidated holding company for the first quarter ended March 31, 2025.

The company reported an 8.7% increase in net earnings for the quarter compared with the prior-year period. The announcement, released by Globe Newswire, summarizes the bank's operating results and reflects the Board's review of consolidated performance for the period.

Source: GLOBE NEWSWIRE; Author: aktiencheck.de AG.

## Chino Commercial Bancorp Reports First Quarter 2025 Results

CHINO, Calif., April 18, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Board of Directors of Chino Commercial Bancorp (OTC: CCBC), the parent company of Chino Commercial Bank, N.A., announced the results of operations for the Bank and the consolidated holding company for the first quarter ended March 31, 2025.

The company reported an 8.7% increase in net earnings for the quarter compared with the prior-year period. The announcement, released by Globe Newswire, summarizes the bank's operating results and reflects the Board's review of consolidated performance for the period.

Source: GLOBE NEWSWIRE; Author: aktiencheck.de AG.

## Key Takeaways

- 8.7% increase in net earnings for the quarter compared with the prior-year period.
- Results cover the Bank and the consolidated holding company for the quarter ended March 31, 2025.
- Announcement released via Globe Newswire; reflects the Board’s review of consolidated performance.
